title: Hollow colliders for the open containers of Apartment 1122 (OUR merged model only; the pack is not changed)
basis: by geometry, not verified in simulation
how_to_apply: In the room builder, for each body listed: remove the geoms in remove_geoms (the pack's solid convex hull) and add the boxes (MJCF: type box, size = half sizes, pos/quat in the BODY frame, quat w x y z, mass 0, group 3, invisible). The body's explicit <inertial> stays, so mass and inertia are unchanged. Visual mesh unchanged. make_hollow_colliders.apply_to_body(el, entry) does it on the ElementTree body element; run it before the builder sets contype/conaffinity of loose bodies.
why: The pack collides every dish as ONE solid convex hull (no inside): a jaw cannot enter a cup, so a rim pinch is impossible until the collider is hollow.

rules.wall_sectors: 8 (outer radius up to 5 cm), 10 (up to 8 cm), 12 (larger); 1 or 2 tilted segments high
rules.floor: 1 square box (base radius under 6 cm) or 4 bars turned 45 deg (octagon); 2 layers when the solid base widens by over 1 cm
rules.handles: one box per handle / spout (at most 2)
rules.outer_face: halfway between the inscribed and the circumscribed polygon of the outer surface (within about 1.5 mm of it), inner face on the inner surface (inside clear), walls at least 3 mm
